## Pull request overview

This PR completes the ConfigPanel UI Spec alignment by extending ObjectGrid to support all 5 rowHeight enum values (previously hardcoded to only 3) and adding comprehensive test coverage for ViewConfigPanel field interactions, conditional rendering, and boundary cases.

**Changes:**
- Extended ObjectGrid rowHeight support from 3 values (compact/medium/tall) to all 5 spec-defined values (compact/short/medium/tall/extra_tall) with full rendering support including state management, cell styling, cycle toggle logic, and icon mapping
- Added 19 new ViewConfigPanel interaction tests covering toggle interactions, conditional rendering (sharing visibility, navigation width/openNewTab, addRecord sub-editor), all 5 rowHeight button clicks, boundary values (empty actions, long labels, special chars, invalid pageSizeOptions), and enum cycling (densityMode, ARIA live)
- Added 8 new schema-level spec alignment tests verifying field ordering, compound field structure, switch field defaults, and comprehensive visibleWhen predicates
- Added 14 new ObjectGrid rowHeight tests validating initialization, full 5-step cycle, label display, and toggle visibility for all enum values

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Extended rowHeightMode state type to include all 5 values, updated cellClassName mapping with styles for short/extra_tall, modified cycleRowHeight to cycle through all 5 values, added Rows2 icon import, implemented icon mapping via object lookup |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/row-height.test.tsx | New test file with 14 comprehensive tests covering all 5 rowHeight enum values: toggle visibility, initialization, full cycle sequence, label display, and default behavior |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx | Added 19 interaction tests for spec alignment: toggle interactions (collapseAllByDefault, showDescription, clickIntoRecordDetails, addDeleteRecordsInline), conditional rendering (sharing, navigation, addRecord), rowHeight buttons, boundary cases, enum cycling |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/view-config-schema.test.tsx | Added 8 schema-level tests: accessibility field ordering, emptyState compound field structure, switch field default conventions, comprehensive visibleWhen predicates for sharing and navigation |
| ROADMAP.md | Updated Phase 4 test counts and added Phase 5 section documenting spec alignment completion with all changes |
</details>



<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (3)</summary>

**ROADMAP.md:390**
* The count "18 new ViewConfigPanel interaction tests" is incorrect. There are actually 19 new tests added in this PR (lines 2439-2772 of ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx): 4 toggle tests, 4 conditional rendering tests, 1 all-rowHeight test, 2 empty actions tests, 3 boundary tests, 2 pageSizeOptions tests, 1 densityMode test, 1 addRecord conditional test, and 1 ARIA live test.
```
- [x] 18 new ViewConfigPanel interaction tests: collapseAllByDefault, showDescription, clickIntoRecordDetails, addDeleteRecordsInline toggles; sharing visibility conditional hide; navigation width/openNewTab conditional rendering; all 5 rowHeight button clicks; boundary tests (empty actions, long labels, special chars); pageSizeOptions input; densityMode/ARIA live enums; addRecord conditional sub-editor; sharing visibility select
```
**ROADMAP.md:388**
* The issue reference is incorrect. The PR description states this PR "Fixes objectstack-ai/objectui#762", but the ROADMAP references "Issue #745". These should match to ensure proper issue tracking and documentation consistency.
```
**Phase 5 — Spec Alignment Completion (Issue #745):**
```
**packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/row-height.test.tsx:160**
* The test name "should default to 'medium' when rowHeight is defined but empty" doesn't match the test implementation. The test passes `rowHeight: 'medium'` explicitly, which is not testing a default or fallback scenario. The comment mentions that "when schema.rowHeight is undefined, no toggle is shown" which is already tested in the "Row height toggle visibility" describe block. Consider either removing this redundant test or modifying it to test an actual edge case, such as passing an invalid rowHeight value to verify fallback behavior.
```
describe('Row height default', () => {
  it('should default to "medium" when rowHeight is defined but empty', async () => {
    // When rowHeight is present (truthy or not), toggle shows.
    // When schema.rowHeight is undefined, no toggle is shown — default 'medium' is internal.
    renderGrid({ rowHeight: 'medium' });

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByText('Name')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    expect(screen.getByTitle('Row height: medium')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```
</details>
